title: Azure Data Engineer (Fabric & Cloud Data Platform)
descriptionHtml:
Rackspace Technology™ is a leading end-to-end, hybrid cloud and AI solutions company. We can design, build, and operate our customers' cloud environments across all major technology platforms, irrespective of technology stack or deployment model. We partner with our customers at every stage of their cloud journey, enabling them to modernize applications, build new products, and adopt innovative technologies. Named a best place to work by Newsweek and Forbes, we attract and develop world-class talent to deliver a Fanatical Experience™ – so our customers can achieve better outcomes and stay ahead of what’s next.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Azure Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain our enterprise data platform. In this role, you will implement a modern data lakehouse architecture capable of supporting raw and curated data zones, scalable batch processing, and future analytical workloads. You will play a key role in integrating our existing data pipelines, models, and transformation logic into a unified ecosystem built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks. A heavy emphasis is placed on enforcing strict encryption, comprehensive logging, auditing, and fine-grained access controls to secure identifiable data.

Location: on-site with a customer in Central London.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Lakehouse Architecture: Design and optimize a high-performance lakehouse pattern utilizing Microsoft Fabric OneLake and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2).

  • Data Zone Management: Maintain architectural segregation between raw storage (immutability, landing) and curated data zones (cleansed, conformed business layers) while securely handling identifiable data.

  • Scalable Data Processing: Develop, tune, and monitor large-scale batch processing pipelines using Azure Databricks (Spark-based processing) and PySpark.

  • Orchestration & Workflow: Build automated data workflows using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory and Azure Data Factory to move data efficiently across the platform.

  • Legacy & Model Integration: Ensure seamless integration with existing data pipelines, legacy data models, and established transformation logic without breaking downstream analytical operations.

  • Platform Security & Governance: Implement enterprise-grade security baselines including data-at-rest/in-transit encryption, structured logging, automated audit trails, and strict access controls (RBAC, ABAC, and row/column-level security).

  • Future-Proof Analytics: Structure data foundations to readily support future analytical workloads, advanced reporting, and data science use cases.

Required Technical Skills

  • Cloud Platform & Fabric: 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure, with practical exposure to the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem (OneLake, Data Factory, Fabric Lakehouse).

  • Big Data Processing: Deep technical expertise with Apache Spark / Azure Databricks for distributed compute, memory optimization, and Delta Lake formats.

  • Data Engineering Languages: Advanced proficiency in SQL (T-SQL, SparkSQL) and Python (PySpark).

  • Security & Compliance: Direct experience implementing security controls for sensitive or identifiable data, utilizing Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Purview.

  • Data Integration: Proven track record of migrating, refactoring, or connecting legacy SQL/stored procedure logic and existing pipelines into modern cloud formats.

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

  • Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600) is highly advantageous.

  • DevOps/IaC: Experience deploying data infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep, and managing deployments via Git/Azure DevOps.

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical and root-cause debugging skills for distributed Spark jobs and multi-stage pipelines.

  • Ability to collaborate with compliance and security teams to validate data privacy baselines.

  • Strong communication skills to bridge technical delivery with business intelligence requirements.

title: Software Developer IV (Golang & Kubernetes)
descriptionHtml:
About the opportunity

At Rackspace Technology we deliver outcome-based cloud solutions that help customers modernise applications, launch new products, and run complex cloud environments. RackAI is our strategic platform for bringing secure, scalable, cloud-native AI capabilities to customers and internal teams alike.

We're looking for an expert Software Developer IV to join the PVC Product Software Engineering team and help design and evolve the core of RackAI. You'll pair deep Go and Kubernetes expertise with genuine architectural leadership — and you'll help set the standard for how a modern engineering team builds software in the age of AI. It's a hands-on senior role: strategic enough to shape direction, close enough to the code to lead by example.

Put simply: we build AI, and we build with AI. If you want to work at the intersection of cloud-native platform engineering and applied AI — and help define an AI-first engineering culture — this is the seat.

Why RackAI

You'll help shape the future of AI-powered products at Rackspace Technology — building with modern cloud-native technology, solving hard problems at scale, and setting the standard for how engineering teams work in an AI-first world.

What you'll do

Architect and build the RackAI platform

  • Design and develop highly scalable backend services in Go (Golang).
  • Build Kubernetes-native applications — operators, controllers, and platform services — using controller-runtime and kubebuilder.
  • Define and evolve the RackAI platform architecture for growth, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Develop the APIs, automation frameworks, and platform capabilities that power AI-enabled products.
  • Champion cloud-native best practices: observability, resiliency, and operational readiness.

Lead an AI-first engineering culture

  • Make AI-assisted engineering the default way of working — champion an AI-driven, AI-first approach across the team.
  • Embed AI development tooling — Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, or GitHub Copilot — across the lifecycle, from design and coding through testing, review, and documentation.
  • Set the standards and guardrails for responsible, effective use of AI coding assistants — code quality, security, licensing, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Turn AI augmentation into measurable gains in velocity and quality through prompt engineering and agentic workflows.
  • Coach engineers to get real leverage from AI tooling, and continually assess what to adopt next.

Engineer the platform and infrastructure

  • Design and optimise Kubernetes deployments across multiple environments.
  • Automate provisioning, deployment, scaling, and lifecycle management.
  • Partner with Platform Engineering to raise developer productivity and platform reliability.
  • Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, and operational requirements.

Lead and mentor

  • Provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams.
  • Lead architectural reviews and design discussions, and set coding standards and patterns.
  • Mentor Software Developers I–III and grow engineering capability across the group.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments.

Collaborate across the organisation

  • Work closely with Product, Architecture, Data Science, SRE, and Security.
  • Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Communicate architectural decisions and technical strategy to stakeholders.
  • Contribute to roadmap planning and long-term platform evolution.

What you'll bring

Core software engineering

  • Expert-level Go (Golang) development.
  • Deep Kubernetes expertise — architecture, operations, and application development.
  • Proven experience with distributed systems and microservices architectures.
  • Strong command of RESTful APIs, event-driven systems, and service-oriented architecture.
  • Hands-on with container technologies such as Docker and OCI-compliant runtimes.
  • Solid grounding in software design patterns, CI/CD, DevOps, Git-based workflows, and secure coding practices.

Experience

  • Nine or more years in software development, including five or more years writing production Go.
  • Demonstrable experience building Kubernetes operators or controllers with controller-runtime or kubebuilder.
  • A track record of delivering production-grade cloud-native applications.
  • Experience leading complex technical projects end to end, and mentoring engineers to a higher standard.

AI-assisted development

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, and GitHub Copilot, integrated effectively into day-to-day engineering.
  • A genuine commitment to working within — and helping to shape — an AI-first development culture.

AI and machine learning

  • Practical understanding of modern Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Familiarity with open-source foundation models such as Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, or DeepSeek.
  • Understanding of AI inference concepts, including model serving, latency, throughput, batching, performance improvements, optimizations, benchmarking of model inference?.
  • Knowledge of model fine-tuning techniques, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), LoRA, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT).
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search.
  • Experience integrating AI models into production applications using APIs or self-hosted inference platforms.

AI platform and infrastructure

  • Experience with containerised AI workloads on Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with AI serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of GPU-accelerated computing and how AI workloads are deployed on modern GPU infrastructure.
  • Experience deploying scalable AI applications in cloud or private cloud environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience building AI/ML platforms or AI-enabled enterprise products.
  • Advanced work with CRDs and operator patterns.
  • Cloud platforms — AWS preferred; Azure or Google Cloud also welcome.
  • Service mesh technologies and platform-engineering concepts.
  • Observability stacks such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar.
  • Contributions to open-source projects.

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Full Stack Developer

The Opportunity:

We’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated Full Stack Developer to join a small, high-impact team supporting Intelligence Community operations in the CBRN mission space. This is a unique opportunity to develop innovative, cloud-based tools that enhance operational awareness, data analysis, and decision-making for real-world intelligence challenges. You’ll work in a secure Government Cloud environment collaborating closely with analysts, data scientists, and mission partners to deliver scalable, production-ready solutions.

If you’re passionate about transforming complex data into intuitive, secure applications and want your work to directly impact national defense then this role is for you.

Join us. The world can’t wait.  

You Have:   

  • 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer, Data Engineer, or Software Developer

  • Experience supporting the Intelligence Community or Department of Defense environments

  • Experience with Python and working with databases

  • Experience with big data frameworks such as Spark, PySpark, or Elastic Search

  • Experience with data visualization platforms such as Kibana, Foundry Workshop, or Palantir

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and development in classified environments

  • TS/SCI clearance

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Data Science

Nice If You Have:   

  • Experience supporting CBRN, WMD, counterproliferation, or related mission areas

  • Experience with CBRN analytical data systems or modeling tool

  • Possession of strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.

  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Data Engineer

The Opportunity: 

Ever-expanding technology like IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence means that there’s more structured and unstructured data available today than ever before. As a data engineer, you know that organizing data can yield pivotal insights when it’s gathered from disparate sources. We need an experienced data engineer like you to help our clients find answers in their data to impact important missions.

As a data engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll implement data engineering activities on some of the most mission-driven projects in the industry. You’ll deploy and develop pipelines and workflows that organize and make disparate data meaningful.

Here, you’ll work with and guide a multi-disciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast-paced, agile environment. You’ll use your experience in analytical exploration and data examination while you manage the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of analytic solutions for your clients.  

Join us. The world can’t wait. 

You Have:   

  • 3+ years of experience utilizing programming and querying languages, including Python, R, Scala, or SQL
  • 3+ years of experience developing and maintaining data applications for reporting and analytics
  • 3+ years of experience creating software for retrieving, parsing, and processing structured and unstructured data 
  • 3+ years of experience building scalable ETL or ELT workflows for reporting and analytics 
  • Experience creating solutions within a collaborative, cross-functional team environment 
  • Secret clearance 
  • Bachelor’s degree

  • Experience with Maven Smart Systems tools such as Foundry
  • Experience with data visualization or geospatial tools such as Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, or ArcGIS

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
DevOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how. As a DevOps engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. We need you to help us develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges.
 
As a platform DevOps engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change. On our team, you’ll strengthen your skills using the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to improve your client’s environment with current container software to ensure seamless orchestration. Using your DevOps platform knowledge, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process.

You’ll work with your team to recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll gain DevOps skills and experience while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.   

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.
 
Join us. The world can’t wait.  

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience with containerization technologies

  • 2+ years of experience with container orchestration platforms

  • 2+ years of experience managing software deployments through CI/CD pipelines

  • Experience developing enterprise cloud-native solutions and applying basic principles, theories, and concepts

  • Experience with OOP scripting or program languages

  • Ability to work with AWS or Azure

  • Secret clearance

  • HS diploma or GED

  • Knowledge of creating and improving continuous automation across multiple technical stacks

  • Knowledge of creating and improving continuous deployment tools built on Kubernetes

You’ll deploy and develop pipelines and platforms that organize and make disparate data meaningful. Here, you’ll work with and guide a multi-disciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast-paced, agile environment. You’ll use your experience in analytical exploration and data examination while you manage the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of scalable platforms for your clients. 

Work with us to use data for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait. 

You Have:   

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, application development, or data science

  • 5+ years of experience designing, developing, operationalizing, and maintaining complex data applications at enterprise scale 

  • 3+ years of experience creating software for retrieving, parsing, and processing structured and unstructured data 

  • 3+ years of experience building scalable ETL or ELT workflows for reporting and analytics 

  • 3+ years of experience utilizing programming and querying languages, including Python, R, Scala, or SQL 

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, or Foundry

  • Experience creating solutions within a collaborative, cross-functional team environment 

  • Secret clearance 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Mathematics

Nice If You Have:   

  • Experience with Palantir tools such as Foundry or Gaia 

  • Experience with DoW financial information systems

  • Experience with DoD data analytics systems such as Advana or Vantage

  • Experience with distributed data and computing tools including Spark, Databricks, Hadoop, Hive, AWS EMR, or Kafka 

  • Experience with Agile engineering practices 

  • Experience working within a Combatant Command or other DoD organization

  • TS/SCI clearance

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer

The Opportunity:

As a back-end developer, you know that a good site or system needs the right combination of clean code, APIs, analytics, and infrastructure to develop a user-focused solution. We’re looking for an experienced back-end developer with the software engineering skills it takes to identify potential risks, contribute to solution development, and create efficient and effective systems for our clients. 

As a back-end developer at Booz Allen, you’ll use the latest architectural approaches and open-source frameworks and tools to deliver solutions. Using your software engineering experience, you’ll work with the development team to create custom tools, systems, and sites with consistent performance and scalability. 

In this role, you’ll make a mission-forward impact as you further your skillset and career. Work with us as we shape systems for the better.  

Join us. The world can’t wait. 

You Have: 

  • 5+ years of experience implementing, maintaining, and supporting agile software development to modernize systems 
  • 5+ years of experience in software development using basic programming languages, technologies, tools, or web development stacks 
  • 3+ years of experience with Python programming
  • Experience creating solutions to complex problems within a collaborative, cross-functional team  
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor's degree or 8+ years of experience in software engineering in lieu of a degree

 Nice If You Have:  

  • Experience with hypervisors or virtualization technology such as kvm, VMWare, or Proxmox
  • Experience developing and managing CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with automated test development
  • Experience with Server-Side Development, Middleware, Application or Data Integration, API Development, Core Application Systems

descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer

The Opportunity: 

Booz Allen is looking for a Software Engineer who is driven by purpose and ready to build software that directly supports mission‑critical operations across the space domain. In this role, you’ll design, develop, and enhance the software developed for ground systems and the real‑time capabilities that space missions rely on.

You’ll take ownership of complex engineering challenges from modernizing legacy components to architecting new mission‑focused capabilities that improve performance, resilience, and operational speed. Your work will shape how data is processed, how systems communicate, and how mission teams execute with precision.

This role is built for someone who thrives on solving hard problems, embraces innovation, and understands the responsibility of building software that must perform flawlessly. If you’re motivated by mission impact, energized by technical depth, and ready to engineer solutions that advance GEOINT and space operations, we want to meet you.

Work with us as we shape systems for the better.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer

The Opportunity:

As a full-stack developer, you will maintain and execute a network of simulators and modeling capabilities focused on providing rehearsal and exercise capabilities for various units. These simulators are in different locations throughout the country, and the client’s engineering team is responsible for managing the network, maintaining an Authority to Connect (ATO), improving system design and architecture, tier 1-3 troubleshooting during operations, hardware installs, lifecycle management, software releases and deployment, new features, and innovation.

The software engineering team works on compiling and running from the provided source code, setting up their CI/CD pipeline, breaking down operational requirements for the simulator into manageable tasks or features in JIRA, implementing the tasks or features with various programming languages, assisting in innovation initiatives for the program, improving their skills and knowledge through training opportunities, integrating with other applications and simulations, and creating or improving upon their development environment.

As a Software Engineer, you will be operating on an Agile Scrum team and are expected to have daily communication. This job requires personnel who are skilled and effective programmers that can provide onsite support when needed. You will have a lot of growth opportunities within the program and areas for innovation on simulation systems.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:   

  • 5+ years of experience with Java, C++, or C#

  • Experience working on simulation systems

  • Experience writing source code for new applications or generating and enhancing code samples for existing applications 

  • Knowledge of Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) networking protocol

  • TS/SCI clearance 

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Experience with Python, JavaScript, or SQL

  • Experience in DevSecOps

  • Experience working with JIRA

title: ServiceNow Platform Engineer - Insurance Smart Apps
descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) helps insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions. A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets. You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.

We are seeking an experienced Senior ServiceNow Platform Engineer to manage, enhance, and optimize the ServiceNow platform across enterprise environments. This role combines platform administration, engineering, automation, integrations, and operational support to ensure a secure, reliable, scalable, and high-performing ServiceNow environment.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform administration and a solid understanding of ServiceNow development, JavaScript, integrations, and enterprise IT operations. This position will work closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, networking, and application teams to deliver platform capabilities and continuously improve the ServiceNow ecosystem.

Approximately 20% of the role will focus on ServiceNow development and automation, with the remaining focus on platform engineering, administration, reliability, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, and optimize the ServiceNow platform across development, test, and production environments.
  • Ensure platform availability, stability, security, scalability, and performance through proactive monitoring and administration.
  • Plan and execute ServiceNow upgrades, patches, instance cloning, releases, and environment maintenance.
  • Configure and manage ServiceNow users, groups, roles, access controls, system properties, certificates, and other platform components.
  • Administer and support MID Servers, integrations, and connectivity between ServiceNow and enterprise applications.
  • Monitor platform health and performance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, application, and other technology teams to support enterprise integrations and platform initiatives.
  • Support ServiceNow ITSM capabilities and ensure platform configurations align with security, governance, and ServiceNow best practices.
  • Coordinate platform changes, maintenance activities, releases, and disaster recovery processes while minimizing disruption to business operations.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture standards, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and runbooks.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain ServiceNow solutions using JavaScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP integrations.
  • Build automation and reusable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve platform efficiency and reliability.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and internal or third-party systems using REST APIs, SOAP, MID Servers, and other integration technologies.
  • Participate in incident, problem, and root cause analysis activities involving the ServiceNow platform.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, reliability, automation, security, and user experience.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance on ServiceNow administration, development, automation, and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in IT, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering and/or engineering the ServiceNow platform.
  • Strong experience with ServiceNow platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and operational support.
  • Experience with ServiceNow upgrades, patches, cloning, releases, instance management, and platform maintenance.
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow security, roles, ACLs, users, groups, system properties, and platform configuration.
  • Hands-on experience with JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting.
  • Experience with ServiceNow development components such as Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer, and/or related platform capabilities.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting REST and SOAP integrations and working with APIs.
  • Experience with MID Servers and enterprise system integrations.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with ITSM processes and enterprise technology environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) or other relevant ServiceNow certifications.
  • Experience with additional ServiceNow modules beyond core ITSM.
  • Experience with ServiceNow IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, or advanced automation capabilities.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer / Project Manager to support and maintain critical infrastructure environments. This role combines hands-on infrastructure engineering, project ownership, operational coordination, and technical leadership.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, AWS, patch management, and vulnerability remediation, along with the organizational skills needed to manage projects, coordinate cross-functional teams, track deliverables, and communicate status effectively.

This position requires a highly accountable professional who can serve as a trusted technical resource, take ownership of critical work, and provide guidance and mentorship to less experienced team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows Server 2019 and newer environments.
  • Manage user access, network interface configuration, operating system settings, and server-related issues.
  • Administer Active Directory, including:
    • User and access management
    • Group Policy Object (GPO) creation and implementation
    • Trust relationship configuration
    • Domain controller promotion and demotion
    • Design and implementation of new Active Directory environments
  • Support Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Ubuntu environments, including core operating system administration, command-line operations, and basic shell scripting.
  • Support and maintain infrastructure hosted in AWS environments.
  • Manage operating system patching activities using enterprise patch management tools, including deployment group creation, scheduling, deployment, and validation.
  • Conduct vulnerability scanning and remediation activities using platforms such as Rapid7.
  • Analyze vulnerability scan results, identify remediation requirements, and coordinate corrective actions with appropriate technical teams.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, action items, and deliverables.
  • Create and present Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs) and provide regular project status updates.
  • Coordinate meetings and work across infrastructure, security, application, and other technical teams to ensure timely completion of activities.
  • Identify project risks, dependencies, and potential delays and escalate issues proactively.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for infrastructure, projects, remediation activities, hardware, and software.
  • Develop and maintain tracking tools and reports using Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, calculations, data comparisons, spreadsheet consolidation, and project trackers.
  • Serve as a primary technical point of contact for assigned infrastructure environments and coordinate issue resolution across multiple teams.
  • Monitor and maintain infrastructure environments to support availability, security, compliance, and operational requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and mentorship to less experienced team members.
  • Continuously learn new technologies and develop an understanding of the broader business and operational environment.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2019 or newer.
  • Advanced experience with Active Directory administration and architecture.
  • Working knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Ubuntu.
  • Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and services.
  • Experience with enterprise patch management and vulnerability remediation.
  • Experience with tools such as Ivanti and Rapid7 or comparable platforms.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, milestone tracking, execution, risk management, and status reporting.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas/calculations, data comparison, and tracker development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and understand complex technical environments.
  • Experience providing technical leadership, coaching, or mentorship to other team members.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.
  • Experience coordinating infrastructure projects involving multiple technical teams.
  • Experience with infrastructure security, vulnerability management, and compliance activities.
  • Familiarity with hybrid cloud environments and enterprise data center operations.
  • Experience developing technical documentation, operational procedures, and project reporting.
  • Relevant technical certifications in Microsoft, AWS, Linux, IT infrastructure, or project management are a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Technical expertise: Strong infrastructure engineering and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Project ownership: Ability to plan, coordinate, execute, and track complex technical initiatives.
  • Leadership: Ability to take ownership of critical responsibilities and mentor other team members.
  • Organization: Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly communicate technical information, project status, risks, and required actions.
  • Accountability: Reliable ownership of assigned environments, projects, and deliverables.
  • Adaptability: Quick learner who can understand changing technologies, environments, and business requirements.

title: Storage Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

Storage Engineer (NetApp)

(Hybrid)

Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.

Overview

We are seeking a motivated Storage Engineer with experience or a strong interest in NetApp storage technologies to join a major infrastructure programme delivering project-based storage solutions within a secure environment.

This role will provide the opportunity to work alongside senior engineers and architects, supporting the delivery of storage projects including deployments, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh activities. The successful candidate will develop hands-on experience across enterprise storage platforms while contributing to the successful implementation of infrastructure solutions within complex environments.

There are no operational support responsibilities associated with this position, with the focus being on project delivery and technical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the implementation and configuration of NetApp storage solutions.
  • Support storage infrastructure projects, including migrations, upgrades, and technology refresh activities.
  • Carry out storage provisioning, configuration, and deployment tasks under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Assist with implementing storage replication, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Work collaboratively with server, virtualisation, network, and cloud teams to support integrated infrastructure projects.
  • Participate in technical workshops and project meetings.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, implementation records, and project deliverables.
  • Support testing, validation, and transition activities.
  • Ensure delivered solutions comply with security, governance, and technical standards.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement activities and knowledge sharing within the team.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Experience working with enterprise storage technologies, preferably NetApp.
  • Basic understanding of storage concepts including RAID, snapshots, replication, and capacity management.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure projects or technical implementations.
  • Familiarity with SAN and NAS technologies and storage networking concepts.
  • Knowledge of virtualisation platforms such as VMware vSphere.
  • Understanding of backup and disaster recovery principles.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and develop technical skills within a project environment.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Exposure to NetApp ONTAP administration.
  • Familiarity with storage migration activities.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.
  • Understanding of automation or scripting technologies such as PowerShell.
  • Relevant vendor certifications or progress towards certification (NetApp, VMware, Microsoft, etc.).

Personal Attributes

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Positive, proactive, and solution-focused approach.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

title: Principal Data Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionText:
Principal data engineers at Thoughtworks are strategic leaders who spearhead data engineering initiatives, tackle complex business challenges and uncover transformative insights. They possess a deep understanding of a client's business ecosystem and partner with executives to align technology strategies with business objectives. By contextualizing emerging trends and Thoughtworks' exploration, they expand the impact of data engineering within the client organization.

They draw upon their profound expertise in developing modern data architectures and infrastructure for the management of data applications. Effective collaboration is paramount, as they adeptly convey their discoveries to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. They stay abreast of industry advancements, ensure data quality and security, and provide mentorship to team members. At Thoughtworks, data engineers leverage deep technical knowledge to solve complex business problems, making a significant impact on client success.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation to manage. The role is based in Germany and requires regular travel to client sites, up to approximately 50% of your time.

Job responsibilities

  • You will collaborate with sales and pre-sales to clarify requirements, design viable solutions and independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders.
  • You will establish a clear vision and direction for the data paradigm and practices, aligning it with the overall business strategy.
  • You will collaborate with executive-level stakeholders to understand their strategic objectives and identify opportunities to leverage data and data quality.
  • You will consult on complex data platform programs, synchronizing cross-cutting architectural concerns and providing client-facing technical leadership as a data subject-matter expert.
  • You will create, design and develop intricate data processing pipelines, addressing clients' most challenging problems.
  • You will collaborate with data scientists to design scalable implementation and production of their models.
  • You will write clean and iterative code based on TDD and leverage continuous-delivery practices to deploy, support and operate data pipelines.
  • You will design and implement the strategy around data governance, data security and data privacy to support business and compliance requirements.
  • You will grow the capability around you, mentoring engineers and building out the next generation of the team.
  • You lead through influence rather than headcount: growing capability and raising delivery standards inside the organisation, while building our presence in the market through thought leadership, ecosystem initiatives and client-facing points of view.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

         
  • You must have extensive pre-sales experience and a proven ability to independently drive complex pursuits and create winning commercial proposals.
  • You are equally happy coding and leading a team to implement a solution, and you stay hands-on in at least one or two core technologies.
  • You have experience in system design using Domain-Driven Design for enterprise organisations with various domains.
  • Working with data excites you; you have created big-data architecture, can build and operate data pipelines, and maintain data storage within distributed systems.
  • You have a deep understanding of data modeling and experience with modern data engineering tools and platforms, along with cloud warehousing tools.
  • You have built and deployed large-scale data pipelines and data-centric applications using distributed storage and processing platforms in a production setting.
  • You have experience designing and developing real-time and low-latency data streaming solutions (cloud and locally hosted).
  • You have experience with data visualization techniques and can communicate the insights as per the audience.
  • You have experience defining and implementing data governance and security policies, and knowledge of MLOps and data science concepts.

Professional Skills

         
  • You have worked in a consultancy or professional-services environment within the last five years, driving data and AI engagements end to end (recent examples matter more than historical ones).
  • You can point to data and AI pursuits you helped win and shape within the last three to five years, including deals from around €3M upwards, and you can speak concretely to their commercial shape, trade-offs and delivery.
  • You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset, for example a reusable accelerator taken to market, combining solutioning, sales and delivery with tangible business outcomes.
  • You stay genuinely hands-on: you can build alongside your team when it counts and are comfortable being the deepest engineer in the room.
  • You bring significant hands-on and leadership experience in data and AI (typically 10+ years) and, above all, the appetite to keep building: growing accounts, teams and capability rather than only overseeing them.
  • You have fluent German skills (C1)

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

title: Senior Developer - Python Fullstack
descriptionText:
Senior Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result whilst consistently advocating for better engineering practices. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Senior Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard.

For a team to thrive, it needs collaboration and room for healthy, respectful debate. Senior Developers are the technologists who cultivate this environment while driving teams toward delivering on an aspirational tech vision and acting as mentors for more junior-level consultants. Job responsibilities

  • You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns
  • You will use and advocate for continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software as well as value to end customers as early as possible
  • You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients
  • You will create large-scale distributed systems out of microservices
  • You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way.
  • You will apply the latest technology thinking from our Technology Radar to solve client problems
  • You will efficiently utilize DevSecOps tools and practices to build and deploy software, advocating devops culture and shifting security left in development
  • You will oversee or take part in the entire cycle of software consulting and delivery from ideation to deployment and everything in between
  • You will act as a mentor for less-experienced peers through both your technical knowledge and leadership skills

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

    • You have five or more years* of experience
    • You have experience using Python with experience in Object-Oriented programming.
    • You are well versed with React and AWS.
    • You can skillfully write high-quality, well-tested code 
    • You are comfortable with Agile methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP), Scrum and/or Kanban
    • You have a good awareness of TDD, continuous integration and continuous delivery approaches/tools
    • Bonus points if you have working knowledge of cloud technology such as Azure, Kubernetes and Docker

Professional Skills

  • You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed
  • Presence in the external tech community: you willingly share your expertise with others via speaking engagements, contributions to open source, blogs and more
  • You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Onsite Work Expectation

You may be expected to work out of our Thoughtworks office or at our client's office location for all five working days of the week, depending on business or clients’ needs.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design and engineering to drive digital innovation. For 30+ years, our clients have trusted our autonomous teams to build solutions that look past the obvious. Here, computer science grads come together with seasoned technologists, self-taught developers, midlife career changers and more to learn from and challenge each other. Career journeys flourish with the strength of our cultivation culture, which has won numerous awards around the world.

Join Thoughtworks and thrive. Together, our extra curiosity, innovation, passion and dedication overcomes ordinary.

title: Stage - Data Engineer - Aeroline - Toulouse
descriptionHtml:
Description de l'entreprise

Sopra Steria, acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe, avec 51 000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services et solutions numériques. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, en combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des technologies à une approche collaborative. Sopra Steria place l’humain au cœur de son action et s’engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du numérique pour construire un avenir positif. En 2025, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 5,6 milliards d’euros.

The world is how we shape it

Description du poste

Votre rôle et vos missions :

Sous la direction d'un chef de projet Sopra Steria, vous participez à la conception / au développement / aux tests des applications BI / Big Data d'un de nos grands comptes dans le monde de l'aéronautique:

Vous y apprenez/approfondissez vos connaissances des technologies Big Data ( Pyspark, SQL ), de méthodes de développements et de déploiement d'application chez l'un de nos grands comptes.

Le projet auquel vous participez a une vocation opérationnelle (support des processus Achats & Supply Chain du client) et analytique (Dashboards d’aide à la décision pour le management, IA générative pour les développements). Ce projet s’inscrit dans un programme transverse chez notre client visant à optimiser la chaîne d’approvisionnement et réduire autant que possible les interruptions & retard dans la chaîne d’assemblage.
L’ensemble de ces missions se réalise dans un contexte de projet Agile, vous pouvez ainsi mieux appréhender les rôles et missions de chacun dans un cadre SAFe.

Les apports du stage :

  • Analyser / comprendre les besoins du système, analyser et proposer des solutions/technologies en fonction des enjeux et décliner les objectifs techniques associés
  • Appréhender les basiques du développement dans un contexte agile et innovant
  • Prendre part à une mission sur une technologie de pointe de BigData
  • Acquérir & approfondir vos connaissances d'un ou plusieurs domaines techniques et/ou fonctionnels.
  • Évoluer au sein d'un environnement international client et interne

Qualifications

Votre profil :

  • Vous aimez avoir un impact durable, grâce à l’intelligence collective & au digital. Vous êtes curieux(se), passionné(e) de nouvelles technologies et comprenez leurs potentiels. Vous maîtrisez impérativement l’anglais et avez une bonne maitrise des pratiques de développements.
  • Vous possédez des compétences techniques en Python, Sql, Pyspark..
  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en Master, en Ecole d'ingénieur ou formation équivalente.

Informations supplémentaires

  • Un accord télétravail pour télétravailler jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine selon vos missions.
  • Un package avantages intéressants : des titres restaurants, accès aux subventions des activités sociales & culturelles.
  • Des centaines de formations pour développer vos compétences et évoluer au sein du Groupe
  • Des plateformes de formations en autonomie pour vous accompagner votre développement personnel 
  • De très nombreuses opportunités en CDI peuvent vous attendre à l’issue de votre stage 

Employeur inclusif et engagé, notre société œuvre chaque jour pour lutter contre toute forme de discrimination et favoriser un environnement de travail respectueux. C’est pourquoi, attachés à la mixité et à la diversité, nous encourageons toutes les candidatures et tous les profils.

https://www.soprasteria.fr/nous-connaitre/nos-engagements

title: Data Engineer – FEC Screening & Sanction Detection
descriptionHtml:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een mooie toekomst voor iedereen—dat is waar we bij Sopra Steria naartoe werken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen zijn we één van de grootste leveranciers van digital solutions in Europa. We geloven dat niet enkel technologie transformatie aandrijft. Maar dat mensen de kern van verandering vormen Daarom staan mensen ook centraal in alles wat we doen en kun je bij ons zowel individueel als in een team uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Ben jij klaar om écht impact te maken in de strijd tegen financiële criminaliteit?

Als Data Engineer, sta je in de frontlinie om onze klanten en betalingskanalen 24/7 te beschermen. Je werkt samen met experts uit de sector in een agile squad die verantwoordelijk is voor cruciale monitoringssystemen ter detectie van financiële economische criminaliteit (FEC) en sanctieovertredingen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je ondersteunt en verbetert ons complexe IT-landschap dat zorgt voor sanctie- en transactiecontrole.
  • Je bouwt en onderhoudt schaalbare, veilige en kostenefficiënte systemen op RiskShield van INFORM, een realtime fraudepreventiesysteem.
  • Je past regels aan en maakt nieuwe regels in de RiskShield-applicatie, verbetert de prestaties en vermindert het aantal fout-positieve meldingen.
  • Je leidt infrastructurele en functionele verbeteringen binnen de squads Transaction Filtering en Name Screening.
  • Je automatiseert deploys en processen om de omgeving sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken.
  • Je zorgt voor naleving van regelgeving door bevindingen uit audits en modelvalidaties te implementeren.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met een squad van professionals om toekomstbestendige oplossingen te ontwerpen en bouwen.

Wat motiveert jou?

  • Het aanpakken en vereenvoudigen van complexe architectuuruitdagingen.
  • Innoveren met automatisering en slimme technische oplossingen.
  • Bijdragen aan initiatieven met hoge impact op beveiliging en compliance.
  • Werken in een missie gedreven team dat financiële systemen veilig en compliant houdt.
  • Verandering en groei stimuleren in een dynamische omgeving.

Functie-eisen

Wij zijn op zoek naar gepassioneerde collega’s die graag de grenzen verleggen op het gebied van digitale transformatie en technologieconsultancy. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen in een constructieve, samenwerkende teamomgeving, waarbij je werkt aan impactvolle projecten die verandering teweegbrengen voor onze klanten. Als je gedijt op uitdagingen en (de meeste van) de onderstaande kwalificaties bezit, kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie!

Type dienstverband: Hybride
Locatie: Nieuwegein
Aantal uren: 36-40 uur werkweek
Contractduur: Eén jaar, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband
Opleiding: Je hebt een hbo- of wo-opleiding afgerond
Talen: Nederlands (vereist)

We zoeken iemand met de volgende vaardigheden:

  • Minimaal 2,5 jaar relevante werkervaring
  • Ervaring met Agile-methodologieën
  • Technisch sterk in cloudomgevingen en automatisering
  • Kennis van: Python, PySpark, Microsoft Azure, Linux
  • Power BI en datavisualisatie
  • Kennis en ervaring op het gebied van security, waaronder: Vulnerability Management, Azure Compliance

Daarnaast breng je de volgende persoonlijke vaardigheden mee:

  • Proactief en resultaatgericht, met een passie voor beveiliging en efficiëntie
  • Sterke communicator en teamspeler, met oog voor wat het team nodig heeft om te slagen
  • Goed in plannen en samenwerken
  • Ervaren in het aanpakken van complexe vraagstukken binnen een dynamische omgeving

 

Aanvullende informatie

Je zal deel uitmaken van een grote naam in de tech wereld die bekend is om consulting, digitale diensten en softwareontwikkeling. Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen. Daarnaast maak je ook deel uit van onze Data area.

Bij Sopra Steria – Financial Economic Crime (FEC) voorzien we banken en financiële instellingen van digitale tools om risico’s te beheren, klanten te beschermen en de impact van financiële economische criminaliteit te beperken. Als poortwachters van het financiële systeem spelen banken een cruciale rol in de bescherming van onze economie tegen criminele inmenging. Daardoor worden financiële instellingen onderworpen aan steeds strengere regelgeving en toezicht. Tegelijkertijd maken wereldwijde economische instabiliteit en steeds geavanceerdere, technologiegedreven financiële criminaliteit het werk van banken steeds moeilijker.

Enkele cijfers: Naar schatting wordt jaarlijks 16 miljard euro aan crimineel geld witgewassen in Nederland. Minder dan 1% van de criminele geldstromen die via het mondiale banksysteem gaan, wordt daadwerkelijk gestopt. Daarom moeten banken hun aanpak radicaal veranderen in de strijd tegen FEC. Gelukkig zijn er tactische veranderingen die banken snel kunnen doorvoeren om het effect van financiële economische criminaliteit te verminderen.

Klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière? Dan wijzen we je graag in de juiste richting. Met kantoren in bijna 30 landen die je leiden naar plaatsen waar je nog nooit bent geweest. Wil je liever intern groeien? Ook dat is mogelijk. We dagen je uit om jezelf te blijven uitdagen en zo telkens de beste versie van jezelf te zijn.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract en een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.100,- en € 7.800,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur per week);
  • Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
  • Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
  • Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
  • Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
  • Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
  • Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
  • Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.

Ben je enthousiast over deze rol en klaar om samen met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw reactie!

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

Je werkt nauw samen met een squad van professionals om toekomstbestendige oplossingen te ontwerpen en bouwen. Wat motiveert jou? Het aanpakken en vereenvoudigen van complexe architectuuruitdagingen. Innoveren met automatisering en slimme technische oplossingen. Bijdragen aan initiatieven met hoge impact op beveiliging en compliance. Werken in een missie gedreven team dat financiële systemen veilig en compliant houdt. Verandering en groei stimuleren in een dynamische omgeving. Functie-eisen Wij zijn op zoek naar gepassioneerde collega’s die graag de grenzen verleggen op het gebied van digitale transformatie en technologieconsultancy. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen in een constructieve, samenwerkende teamomgeving, waarbij je werkt aan impactvolle projecten die verandering teweegbrengen voor onze klanten. Als je gedijt op uitdagingen en (de meeste van) de onderstaande kwalificaties bezit, kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie! Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen. Daarnaast maak je ook deel uit van onze Data area. Bij Sopra Steria – Financial Economic Crime (FEC) voorzien we banken en financiële instellingen van digitale tools om risico’s te beheren, klanten te beschermen en de impact van financiële economische criminaliteit te beperken. Als poortwachters van het financiële systeem spelen banken een cruciale rol in de bescherming van onze economie tegen criminele inmenging. Daardoor worden financiële instellingen onderworpen aan steeds strengere regelgeving en toezicht. Tegelijkertijd maken wereldwijde economische instabiliteit en steeds geavanceerdere, technologiegedreven financiële criminaliteit het werk van banken steeds moeilijker. Enkele cijfers: Naar schatting wordt jaarlijks 16 miljard euro aan crimineel geld witgewassen in Nederland. Minder dan 1% van de criminele geldstromen die via het mondiale banksysteem gaan, wordt daadwerkelijk gestopt. Daarom moeten banken hun aanpak radicaal veranderen in de strijd tegen FEC. Gelukkig zijn er tactische veranderingen die banken snel kunnen doorvoeren om het effect van financiële economische criminaliteit te verminderen. Klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière? Dan wijzen we je graag in de juiste richting. Met kantoren in bijna 30 landen die je leiden naar plaatsen waar je nog nooit bent geweest. Wil je liever intern groeien? Ook dat is mogelijk. We dagen je uit om jezelf te blijven uitdagen en zo telkens de beste versie van jezelf te zijn. Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol. title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Sopra Steria biedt op maat gemaakte end-to-end corporate technologie en software solutions aan die organisaties helpen gedurfde keuzes te maken en resultaten te boeken. En met succes! Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen behoren we tot de top van de Europese digital solutions leveranciers. Succesvolle organisaties in Europa vertrouwen op onze technologie omdat we blijven streven naar innovatie, samenwerking en zakelijke ontwikkeling.

The world is how we shape it.

Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Bouw het fundament voor data & AI

Data vormt de basis van vrijwel iedere strategische beslissing. Of het nu gaat om rapportages, analytics, procesoptimalisatie of AI: zonder een sterk data platform is geen enkele organisatie echt datagedreven.

Als Data Engineer speel jij daarin een sleutelrol. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en optimaliseert moderne data platformen waarmee organisaties hun data betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig kunnen inzetten. Je verbindt databronnen, ontwikkelt data pipelines en zorgt ervoor dat data beschikbaar is voor dashboards, analyses, data-uitwisseling en AI-toepassingen.

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende projecten voor grote organisaties in Nederland. Soms bouw je mee aan een volledig nieuw data platform, soms help je organisaties hun bestaande omgeving te moderniseren of klaar te maken voor AI-gedreven toepassingen.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van data pipelines en ETL/ELT-processen;
  • Integreren van data uit interne en externe bronnen;
  • Ontwikkelen van data platformen in moderne cloudomgevingen;
  • Modelleren, transformeren en ontsluiten van data voor analytics, BI en AI;
  • Verbeteren van performance, schaalbaarheid en datakwaliteit;
  • Meedenken over data architectuur en technische keuzes;
  • Samenwerken met architecten, data scientists, analisten en business stakeholders.

Je krijgt veel ruimte om jezelf technisch verder te ontwikkelen en werkt met technologieën die organisaties helpen hun datafundament klaar te maken voor de volgende generatie analytics- en AI-oplossingen.

Waar ga je mee werken?

Afhankelijk van de klant en opdracht werk je onder andere met:

  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Azure Synapse Analytics
  • Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Databricks
  • Snowflake
  • SQL
  • Python
  • Spark
  • Git & CI/CD
  • Kubernetes
  • AWS

Functie-eisen

Wij zijn op zoek naar Data Engineers die energie krijgen van complexe datavraagstukken en graag bouwen aan moderne data platformen. Je bent technisch sterk, blijft jezelf ontwikkelen en voelt je prettig in een omgeving waarin samenwerking met klanten en collega's centraal staat.

Type dienstverband: Hybride
Locatie: Nieuwegein
Aantal uren: 32-40 uur per week
Contracttype: Vast
Opleiding: hbo of wo in een relevante richting
Talen: Nederlands (vereist)

Jij brengt mee

  • Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Engineer of vergelijkbaar;
  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van data pipelines en data integratieoplossingen;
  • Sterke kennis van SQL;
  • Ervaring met Python;
  • Ervaring met cloudplatformen, bij voorkeur Microsoft Azure;
  • Kennis van datamodellering en data platform architecturen;
  • Ervaring met technologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory of Synapse Analytics is een pré;
  • Ervaring met Git, CI/CD en DevOps-principes is een pré;
  • Interesse in de ontwikkelingen rondom Data & AI.
  • Vloeiende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (C1/C2), mondeling en schriftelijk

Jij bent

  • Analytisch en oplossingsgericht;
  • Nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën;
  • Communicatief vaardig;
  • Proactief en zelfstandig;
  • Een teamspeler die graag kennis deelt.

 

Aanvullende informatie

Je zal deel uitmaken van een grote naam in de techwereld die bekend is om consulting, digitale diensten en softwareontwikkeling. Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen. Daarnaast maak je ook deel uit van onze Data area binnen de consultingtak van Sopra Steria.

Binnen de Data area creëren wij duurzame waarde bij onze klanten op het gebied van data, analytics en AI. Wij helpen organisaties om beter gebruik te maken van hun data, processen slimmer in te richten en hun datafundament klaar te maken voor de uitdagingen van morgen.

Je wordt onderdeel van een community van ruim 170 data professionals. Samen beschikken we over expertise op het gebied van Data Engineering, Data Governance, Analytics, Data Science, AI en Spatial Intelligence. Door deze disciplines te combineren helpen we klanten met zowel strategische vraagstukken als de realisatie van toekomstbestendige data-oplossingen.

Voor Data Engineers ligt de focus op het bouwen van moderne data platformen die het fundament vormen voor analytics, rapportages en AI-toepassingen. Je werkt met collega's die dezelfde passie voor data delen, krijgt volop mogelijkheden om kennis uit te wisselen en wordt gestimuleerd om je verder te ontwikkelen in de richting die bij jou past.

Wat je kunt verwachten:

  • Uitdagende opdrachten bij grote organisaties in uiteenlopende sectoren;
  • Werken met moderne technologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Databricks en Snowflake;
  • Een actieve community van data specialisten;
  • Veel aandacht voor kennisdeling, innovatie en certificering;
  • Ruimte om door te groeien richting Senior Data Engineer, Architect of Consultant;
  • Een open, pragmatische en professionele werkomgeving waarin eigen initiatief wordt gewaardeerd.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract en een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.000,- en € 6.000,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur per week);
  • Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
  • Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
  • Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
  • Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
  • Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
  • Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
  • Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.

Ben je enthousiast over deze vacature en klaar om samen met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw reactie!

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

title: Stage - Data Engineer - Services Financiers - Bordeaux
descriptionHtml:
Description de l'entreprise

Sopra Steria, acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe, avec 51 000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services et solutions numériques. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, en combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des technologies à une approche collaborative.

Sopra Steria place l’humain au cœur de son action et s’engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du numérique pour construire un avenir positif. En 2025, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 5,6 milliards d’euros.

Description du poste

Description du poste

Contexte du stage :

En tant que stagiaire nous vous proposons de rejoindre notre practice Data Factory localisée à Bordeaux. Constituée de plus de 100 data ingénieurs et expert de la donnée, nous accompagnons les acteurs du marché bancaire dans la mise en œuvre de plateforme data (Dataware, Datamart, Datalake et Lakehouse). 

Vous aurez en nous rejoignant l’opportunité de découvrir des solutions data du marché et d’être formé(e) à leur utilisation, ainsi qu’aux méthodes et pratiques de la data ingénierie.

Votre futur environnement de travail :

En fonction de votre cursus de formation et de vos appétences pour la donnée, vous rejoindrez une de nos équipe projet en totale immersion et serez accompagné(e), formé(e) et même selon le contexte certifié(e) sur toute ou partie des étapes de mise en œuvre et/ou de la maintenance d’une data plateforme, à savoir :

  • L’ingestion des données,
  • le stockage,
  • la préparation des données,
  • la valorisation,
  • l’exposition et la visualisation.

Vous serez amené(e) à concevoir, développer, tester vos propres composants data.

Vos missions sur la période :

Complètement intégré(e) à l'équipe projet, et suivi par un tuteur et des experts, Vous serez amené(e) à :
